Notification Center engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume push notification capability in the binary covers storefront language. iOS, iPadOS, and Connect actually separate Notification Center playback from product-page copy:

  • Notification Center & system notification list — Apple's swipe-down surface from the top edge where users read notification history, stacked groups, and recent alerts. Controls what buyers see when they pull down on their device. Does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Push delivery & UNUserNotificationCenter — engineering work for APNs payloads, notification categories, grouping identifiers, and in-app alert UI. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains Notification Center value to buyers.
  • Settings → Notifications walkthroughs — custom onboarding that points users to per-app alert styles, banners, badges, or notification grouping. Listing copy should match what your gallery shows — a Notification Center stack demo is not a Control Center toggle walkthrough unless that is what the screenshot depicts.

  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of notification support in the app.

Working notification flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.
